children: On Wednesday, September 23, 2026 at 14:00 CEST, Thule will host a conference call with a web presentation. The purpose of the call is to provide investors with a brief update and an opportunity to ask questions before Thule enters its closed period. The Q3 financial results will be published on October 22.
CEO and President Mattias Ankarberg and CFO Toby Lawton will start with a short presentation. A Q&A session will follow the presentation. The meeting will be held in English.
Please join the conference call to ask questions.
The presentation will be published on Thule Group’s website in conjunction with the conference call, and a recording of the web meeting will be available on the site later the same day.
SVP Corporate Communications and Investor Relations

Thule is a global sports and outdoor company. We offer high-quality products with smart features and a sustainable design that make it easy for people across the globe to live an active life. Under the motto
– and with a focus on consumer-driven innovation and long-term sustainability – we develop, manufacture and market products within the product categories
(roof racks, roof boxes and carriers for transporting cycling, water and winter sports equipment, and rooftop tents mounted on a car),
(car seats, strollers, bike trailers, child bike seats and dog transport),
(awnings, bike carriers and tents for RVs and caravans) and
Thule Group has about 3,000 employees at nine production facilities and 35 sales offices worldwide. The Group’s products are sold in 138 markets and in 2025, sales amounted to SEK 10.4 billion.
